info.title: islam.museum static JSON API
info.description: Read-only JSON files generated from the museum's knowledge graph at build time. There is no runtime server: every response is a static file. Prose is CC BY-SA 4.0; structured data is CC0 1.0. See https://github.com/amado2k5/islam-museum/blob/main/docs/data/README.md.

get.description: The Angels Browser dataset: every record tagged angels-browser (named angels, orders and hosts, recording angels, angel-human encounters across the Qur'an, hadith, Seerah and Sunni books) with kind, wings, themes, tags and edges.

200.description: Every angels record with kind, wings, themes, section tags and edges

get.description: The Dream Browser dataset (متصفح الأحلام): every dream the museum's sources mention — Qur'an verses, hadith reports, seerah books and every harvested work — detected at build time plus the curated records tagged dream-browser, each with its corpus section (quran, sunnah, seerah, books, concepts), work, ref, text excerpt, kind, themes and edges.

200.description: Every dream record with corpus section, work, ref, excerpt, kind, themes and edges

get.description: The Du'a Browser dataset (متصفح الأدعية): every supplication the museum's sources mention or write — Qur'anic prayers, hadith reports, seerah books and every harvested work — detected at build time plus the curated records tagged dua-browser, each with its corpus section (quran, sunnah, seerah, books, curated), dua_kind (formula or mention), matched signals, work, ref, text excerpt, kind, themes, tags and edges.

200.description: Every du'a record with corpus section, kind, signals, work, ref, excerpt, themes and edges

get.description: The Islamic Economy Browser dataset (متصفح العملات والصكوك والوقف الإسلامي): every mention of money and Islamic economics, deeds/instruments/covenants, and endowments in the Qur'an, Sunnah, seerah and harvested books — currencies, usury, debt, trade contracts, weights and measures, fiscal dues, waqf and sadaqa jariya — detected at build time plus the curated records tagged islamic-economy-browser, each with its corpus section (quran, sunnah, seerah, books, curated), topic chips (money, sukuk, waqf), matched signals, work, ref, text excerpt, kind, themes, tags and edges.

200.description: Every Islamic-economy record with corpus section, topics, signals, work, ref, excerpt, themes and edges

get.description: The Sayyi'at Browser dataset (متصفح السيئات): every mention of the sayyi'at and the sins theme in the Qur'an, Sunnah, seerah and harvested books — the «سيّئ» family, the names of sin, guilt and disobedience, major and minor sins, transgression, immorality and wrongdoing — detected at build time plus the curated records tagged sayyiat-browser, each with its corpus section (quran, sunnah, seerah, books, curated), sayyiat_kind (sayyi or related), matched signals, work, ref, text excerpt, kind, themes, tags and edges.

200.description: Every sayyi'at record with corpus section, kind, signals, work, ref, excerpt, themes and edges

get.description: The Hasanat Browser dataset (متصفح الحسنات): every mention of the good deeds (al-hasanat) in the Qur'an, Sunnah, seerah and harvested books — «الحسنات»، «حسنات»، «الحسنة»، «حسنة»، the gated «الحسنى», and the fixed collocations «قرضا حسنا» and «بدل حسنا بعد سوء» — detected at build time plus the curated records tagged hasanat-browser, each with its corpus section (quran, sunnah, seerah, books, curated), hasanat_kind (hasanat, hasana or husna), matched signals, work, ref, text excerpt, kind, themes, tags and edges.

200.description: Every good-deed record with corpus section, hasanat kind, signals, work, ref, excerpt, themes and edges

get.description: The Mukatabat Browser dataset (متصفح المكاتبات): every mention of correspondence in the Qur'an, Sunnah, seerah and harvested books — the letters the Prophet sent to kings and emperors, the letters, replies and reports that came back, the caliphs' letters and the chancery institutions, and Sulayman's letter to the Queen of Sheba — detected at build time by a guarded lexicon plus the curated records tagged mukatabat-browser, each with its corpus section (quran, sunnah, seerah, books, curated), mukatabat_kind (letter, mention), sender (prophetic, caliphal, royal, other), matched signals, work, ref, text excerpt, kind, themes, tags and edges.

200.description: Every correspondence record with corpus section, mukatabat kind, sender, signals, work, ref, excerpt, themes and edges

get.description: The Magic and Magicians Browser dataset (متصفح السحر والسحرة): every mention of magic and the magicians in the Qur'an, Sunnah, seerah and harvested books — sorcery, soothsaying and augury, ruqyah, the evil eye and envy — detected at build time plus the curated records tagged magic-browser, each with its corpus section (quran, sunnah, seerah, books, concepts), topic chips, work, ref, text excerpt, kind, themes and edges.

200.description: Every magic record with corpus section, topics, work, ref, excerpt, kind, themes and edges

get.description: The Prophecies and Miracles Browser dataset (متصفح النبؤات وأسرار القرآن ومعجزاته): every prophecy of the Prophet, proof of prophethood, secret and marvel of the Qur'an, miracle of the Prophet, report of unseen knowledge and eschatological prediction in the Qur'an, Sunnah, seerah and harvested books — detected at build time plus the curated records tagged nubuwat-browser, each with its corpus section (quran, sunnah, seerah, books, curated), topics chips, work, ref, text excerpt, kind, themes, tags and edges.

200.description: Every nubuwat record with corpus section, topics, work, ref, excerpt, kind, themes and edges

get.summary: Signs of the Hour Browser dataset
get.description: The Signs of the Hour Browser dataset (متصفح علامات الساعة): every mention of the signs of the Hour and all eschatology in the Qur'an, Sunnah, seerah and harvested books — the major and minor signs, the barzakh, resurrection and gathering, reckoning and the Scale, the Sirat and the Hawd, paradise and hell — detected at build time plus the curated records tagged eschatology-browser, each with its corpus section, topics chips, work, ref, text excerpt, kind, themes and edges.

200.description: Every eschatology record with corpus section, topics, work, ref, excerpt, kind, themes and edges

get.summary: Household of the Prophet Browser dataset
get.description: The Household of the Prophet Browser dataset (متصفح بيت النبوة وآل النبي): everything mentioned about the Prophet's household and family — Ahl al-Bayt, the 'itrah, Banu Hashim and Banu Abd al-Muttalib, the wives, daughters, children and descendants, the imams line — detected at build time plus the curated records tagged bayt-browser, each with its corpus section (quran, sunnah, seerah, books, ahl, mawaqif, concepts), work, ref, text excerpt, kind, themes and edges.

200.description: Every bayt record with corpus section, work, ref, excerpt, kind, themes and edges

get.description: The Jinn & Devils Browser dataset (متصفح الشياطين والجن): every record tagged jinn-devils-browser — jinn, devils and demons, angels, and the dreams that carry them — plus angels-browser angel records, with kind, wings, themes, section tags and edges.

200.description: Every jinn/devils/angels/dreams record with kind, wings, themes, section tags and edges

get.description: The Messengers and Prophets Browser dataset (متصفح الرسل والأنبياء): every mention of the messengers and prophets in the Qur'an, Sunnah, seerah and harvested books — named prophets, the class terms and unnamed prophets — detected at build time and joined to the canonical mentions edges, plus the curated messengers-browser records and the subjects index, each with its corpus section (quran, sunnah, seerah, books, curated), subjects/topics chips, work, ref, text excerpt and edges.

200.description: Every messenger/prophet mention record with corpus section, subjects, topics, work, ref, excerpt and edges, plus the subjects index

get.summary: Divine and Prophetic Miracles Browser dataset
get.description: The Divine and Prophetic Miracles Browser dataset (متصفح المعجزات الإلهية ومعجزات الرسل): every mention of the divine miracles and the prophets' miracles in the Qur'an, Sunnah, seerah and harvested books — the miracle of the Qur'an, the Prophet's signs, the staff, the sea, the she-camel, the ark, the fire, the clay bird, the cradle speech, the heavenly table, Sulayman's signs, the dreams, the annunciation, the covenant chest, the cosmic signs and the destruction of the nations — detected at build time and joined to the canonical mentions edges, plus the curated miracles-browser records and the subjects index, each with its corpus section (quran, sunnah, seerah, books, curated), kind (event/sign/mention), subjects/topics chips, work, ref, text excerpt and edges.

200.description: Every miracle mention record with corpus section, kind, subjects, topics, work, ref, excerpt and edges, plus the subjects index

get.description: The Four Madhhabs Browser dataset (متصفح المذاهب الأربعة): every record tagged madhahib-browser with mh-<section> tags — the four imams and schools, other schools, the salaf forebears, the canonical books, the fiqh/usul concepts — plus every work, passage, event, exhibit or question whose mentions edge names a madhhab group or the madhhab concept, each with its computed sections (aima, hanafi, maliki, shafii, hanbali, ukhra, salaf, kutub, mafahim, dhikr), kind, traditions, themes and edges.

200.description: Every madhhab record with computed sections, kind, traditions, themes and edges

get.description: The Ghayb Browser dataset: every record tagged ghayb-browser (unseen topics — jinn, angels, the soul, time measures, the Ascent, unseen creations, the barzakh, signs of the Hour) with kind, wings, themes, tags and edges.
